description: This header file declares external functions related to reading tokens or lines from a file in the context of the TinySRP implementation. It contains function prototypes for t_nextfield and t_nextline, which likely process input streams during SRP authentication processes. The file also includes licensing information and include guards.

methods.name: t_nextfield
methods.description: Reads the next field (token) from a file stream into a buffer.

methods.name: t_nextline
methods.description: Reads the next line from a file stream.
